subject.title: fix(acp): skip oneshot sessions during startup identity reconcile

question: Should this PR wait for direct startup-reconcile-visible proof, or should maintainers accept the source-level and unit-test evidence for the one-shot skip?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and supported by source inspection, but the posted real-environment proof still does not demonstrate that the real startup scan saw the injected rows.
